P. (दघ्नोति) 
__1 To kill, hurt. 
__2 To go, leap. 
__3 To protect. --

P. (दध्यति) Ved. 
__1 To go, flow. 
__2 To reach, attain. 
__3 To go away.

a. 
(-घ्नी f.) A termination added to nouns in the sense of ‘reaching to’, ‘as high or deep as’; ऊरुदघ्नेन पयसोत्तीर्य [[K.]]; कीलालव्यतिकरगुल्फदध्नपङ्कः (मार्गः) [[
